title: CLI verb alias sweep for observed wrong guesses
description:
Session mining captured live wrong-guess invocations that each cost a failed command plus retry: `dep remove` (3 sessions), `issue complete`, `issue edit`, a three-step guess chain for adding a label to an issue, and cross-group removal-verb guesses (issue delete vs dep rm vs gate remove vs doc remove).

## Background

Removal and edit verbs are spelled differently per command group and natural synonyms are not absorbed. Policy: one canonical spelling per verb in help, synonyms accepted quietly or answered with an actionable hint.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] REQ-01: The removal verb accepts the same synonyms (rm, remove, delete) in the issue, dep, gate, and doc groups, with one canonical spelling shown in help.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-02: `issue complete` and `issue edit` either work as sugar for the state-done update and the update command, or fail with a hint naming the canonical command.
- [ ] [hard] REQ-03: Adding a label to an issue via the naturally guessed label-command spelling either works or the error redirects to the update command's label flag; the label command's help disambiguates namespace management from issue labeling.
